proposal: Reference A only; owner approval required before dependent work
units: CSS px at compact 800x540 viewport with 800x460 usable board; scaled by unchanged T24 boardScale
limitations: Geometry proxies cannot establish player comprehension, beauty or arbitrary-graph feasibility. No generator or 99%/50-attempt success claim. Legacy midpoint diagnostics remain disclosed, not silently waived.

exposedUnique.description: Endpoint on intended country and silhouette boundary; no other country contains/touches it (inherited 1e-6 board-unit geometry tolerance)

competingCountryMargin.description: [designed] endpoint distance to every other same-island country >= 8 CSS px

inwardContinuation.description: [designed] entire reverse continuation of 12 CSS px strictly inside intended country after boundary start

water.description: Unchanged T24 intersections: no land/coast contact except intended endpoint

unrelatedCoastClearance.description: [designed] full polyline distance from unrelated island coast >= 10 CSS px

endpointSpan.description: [designed] direct endpoint distance >= 20 CSS px; a long detour cannot substitute

selfTrace.description: [designed] no zero-length segments, adjacent reversal, or nonadjacent self-contact

routeSeparation.description: [designed] all route pairs >= 10 CSS px apart, including endpoint and shared-country pairs

preserved.description: Every unaffected T24 category, original implementation and parameters
